name: mcp-e2e
description: Drives VS Code's MCP client with a llama.cpp model in the end-to-end tests of test/mcp-e2e.

chatParticipants.name: e2e
chatParticipants.description: Calls MCP tools for the end-to-end tests: /call one tool directly, or /ask the llama.cpp model

commands.name: call
commands.description: Call one MCP tool directly (no model): /call <server> <tool> [<JSON object>]

commands.name: ask
commands.description: Let the llama.cpp model call MCP tools: /ask [<server>] <task> (the #-referenced tools, or else those of <server>)

commands.name: tools
commands.description: List the MCP tools of a server: /tools <server>
